items.title: Darnell Howard Interview, 1957-04-21
items.q: I was a violin teacher. His name was Toad Johnson.

ctx.x: By the way, were you studying at school or with a private teacher?
No, no. I was a violin teacher. His name was Toad Johnson. Old man had whiskies. Yes, sir, what are you doing? Hey, is that thing insured?
Huh? I'll send you a picture. You'll find out.
